sufficiency.title: Quantity Calculator
sufficiency.subtitle: Tell us your guest count and how long the celebration runs — we'll recommend how much of each dish and product to prepare so no table runs empty.

plov.label: Osh (plov)
plov.note: About 300 g of cooked plov per guest — the heart of the Uzbek table, always served generously.

salads.label: Salads
salads.note: Around 150 g per guest across assorted salads (achichuk, olivye and more).

meat.label: Meat dishes
meat.note: Roughly 200 g per guest for kabob and grilled or boiled meats.

bread.label: Non (bread)
bread.note: About half a round non per guest — bread is never in short supply at a wedding.

fruit.label: Fruit
fruit.note: Around 200 g of seasonal fruit per guest for the table.

sweets.label: Sweets & desserts
sweets.note: About 150 g per guest of sweets, pastries and cakes.

drinks.label: Drinks & tea
drinks.note: Around 0.5 L per guest, scaled up for longer celebrations when guests linger.

tableware.label: Disposable tableware
tableware.note: One full set per guest — plate, cup and cutlery — with spares for the buffer.

results.bufferBody: This includes a small buffer so you don't run out if guests bring plus-ones or eat more than expected.
